QuestInfo.name: Cleaning The Nautilus 1
QuestInfo.0: Mrs. Reade, who is in charge of keeping The Nautilus clean, says she is in need of help. Apparently the wash cloths that she uses for cleaning the ship have become tattered from incessant cleaning and she's in need of some new wash cloths... I should go talk to Mrs. Reade myself in the upper deck corridors where she's cleaning.
QuestInfo.1: Go find the #bPig's Ribbons#k, which Mrs. Reade can use as a wash cloth.\n\n#i4000002##t4000002# #b#c4000002##k / 10
QuestInfo.2: Looks like Mrs. Reade's making good use of the pig's ribbon I brought her, but poor Mrs. Reade, she's cleaning all day long...as usual.

0.0: Sigh... what's with all this dust! I keep cleaning and cleaning, yet I don't see any difference whatsoever! Now my towel's about to be completely torn off... and now, it is. Oh no... what should I do...\r\n#L0##b Is there something going on there?#k#l
0.1: Sigh... look at this cleaning towel. I wiped away so much dust that it's already ragged and torn off. I don't have any spare with me... and yet, look at all this dust! How am I going to clean all this? Where can I find a spare cleaning towel?\r\n#L0##b Do you want me to find one for you?#k#l
0.2: Oh, that's very nice of you! Will you do that?

yes.0: I've heard that the Ribbon Pigs at Victoria Island have Ribbons made out of a very dense material that can clean and absorb dust very effectively. I'd really appreciate it if you could get me #b10 Ribbons from the Ribbon Pigs#k. That should be no problem for you, right?

no.0: Look at all this dust! Don't tell me I don't need a cleaning towel right this minute... well, but if you don't clean, this doesn't matter much to you.

1.0: Whoa! You're a quick one. You already brought 10?

yes.0: 1, 2, 3...10! Perfect! I don't know how to thank you. Since I'm so grateful, I'll let you mess up this place just a little bit.

item.0: I said 10 Pig Ribbons. Well...you can get me more if you'd like.
